title: Executive Order 14434: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence (91 FR 63129)

policy_extraction.issuing_body: The White House (President of the United States)
covered_actors: Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST)
Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)

evidence.quote: This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.

enforcement_authorities: Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST)
Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)
compliance_deadlines: Within 60 days of September 29, 2026 (by November 28, 2026): APST, in consultation with agency heads as appropriate, shall submit proposed legislative language to establish a Federal definition of 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI', conforming statutory amendments, and recommendations for additional executive action.
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Signed September 29, 2026 (filed in the Federal Register on October 1, 2026, and published at 91 FR 63129 on October 2, 2026). Directs executive departments and agencies, to the maximum extent permitted by law, to use 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI' instead of 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI' in official correspondence, public communications, websites, reports, policy documents, and other non-statutory documents, and not to acknowledge the usage of 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI' in applicable settings. Does not require altering previously issued regulations, Presidential actions, contracts, grants, or other historical documents. Adopts the existing statutory definition of 'artificial intelligence' in 15 U.S.C. 9401(3) on an interim basis unless superseded by subsequent Presidential action or Act of Congress. Subject to applicable law and availability of appropriations, and creates no legally enforceable rights or benefits.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: Executive Order 14434 justifies replacing 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'Super Intelligence' primarily through an innovation_enablement frame, emphasizing the transformative capabilities, human ingenuity, creativity, scientific and medical breakthroughs, and limitless opportunities created by frontier technologies. Economic_competitiveness is a prominent secondary frame, reflected in references to America standing at the forefront of a technological revolution, world-leading companies, and entrepreneurial spirit; however, innovation_enablement edges it out because the order focuses on celebrating technological promise and scientific advancement rather than framing policy around GDP growth, trade advantage, or zero-sum international economic rivalry. No national security, fundamental rights, consumer safety, social stability, labor transition, or catastrophic risk rationales are invoked.

evidence_spans.quote: They increasingly amplify human ingenuity and unlock new forms of creativity, empowering Americans to achieve what was previously impossible across science, medicine, and nearly every other domain of human endeavor.
The terminology used by the Federal Government should reflect the transformative capabilities of these technologies and the limitless opportunities they create for the American people.
America stands at the forefront of a new technological revolution in intelligence.

Seventy years later, powered by our Nation's unmatched culture of innovation, world-leading companies and research institutions, and entrepreneurial spirit, America is once again pushing the technological frontier forward.
